articles.title: Spain’s World Cup hero Torres saves PSG’s blushes at Rennes
articles.summary: Paris Saint-Germain's Spanish forward Ferran Torres celebrates after scoring during the French Ligue 1 football match between Stade Rennais FC and PSG. (AFP pic) PARIS: Spain's World Cup winner Ferran Torres scored twice to claim a draw for Paris Saint-Germain as they started the defence of their French Ligue 1 title with a 2-2 draw at Rennes.

articles.title: Dung beetles bring poo-sitive news about animals in Central Catchment Nature Reserve
articles.summary: The beetles' unusual diet can give clues about the elusive mammals and birds that roam the forests.

articles.title: Dog Lost on 3rd Tallest Peak in England Finally Found After Three Weeks Stuck on Steep Ravine
articles.summary: A dog missing for nearly three weeks on a mountain in rural England’s Lake District has been rescued—and it was a real team effort. Tiny Teddy vanished on August 2nd while hiking with her owner on Helvellyn, the third-highest peak in the country.

articles.title: Brighton start Premier League season with rout of 10-man Villa
articles.summary: Brighton's Jack Hinshelwood celebrates after scoring against Aston Villa during the match. (AFP pic) BRIGHTON: Brighton launched their Premier League campaign with a dominant 4-0 win over 10-man Aston Villa at the Amex Stadium on Sunday. It took the Seagulls just eight minutes to open the scoring as Maxim de Cuyper forced an own goal from Victor Lindelof before the Belgian made it 2-0 10 minutes later.

articles.title: He Became Both Papa & Mamma for His Little Son ❤️
articles.summary: They say no one can ever take a mother’s place. But Kuldeep Bhardwaj is doing everything he can to be both papa and mamma for his two-and-a-half-year-old son, Sattvik. ❤️ After losing his wife, Kuldeep took on the responsibility of raising their little boy alone—feeding him, caring for him, comforting him and filling his days with love.
articles.llmReason: Genuinely heartwarming story of a father's selfless devotion to raising his son alone after loss, embodying resilience and love.

articles.title: Aaron-Wooi Yik miss out on gold medal after defeat to Chinese pair
articles.summary: World No 4 pair Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik were defeated by top Chinese pair Liang Wei Keng-Wang Chang 21-17, 21-16. (Bernama pic) PETALING JAYA: Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik missed out on becoming the first Malaysians to win two World Championships gold medals after falling to China’s Liang Wei Keng-Wang Chang in the final.
